applyForWork.label: Apply for work
applyForWork.description: Meet the hiring contact. Review the offer before accepting; no wages for applying.

acceptEmployment.label: Accept employment
acceptEmployment.description: Commit to the repeating schedule. First shift is after today.

requestTimeOff.label: Request unpaid time off
requestTimeOff.description: Ask to be excused from today's shift. One approved leave per seven days.

resignFromWork.label: Resign from work
resignFromWork.description: End employment and future obligations. Applications pause for three days; same workplace for seven.

reachOut.label: Reach out
reachOut.description: Make contact and establish a little trust.

askAround.label: Ask around
askAround.description: Learn about people and the property dispute.

askIntroduction.label: Ask for an introduction
askIntroduction.description: Meet the people this contact knows.

spendTime.label: Spend time together
spendTime.description: Build trust, shaped by their values.

requestHelp.label: Request help
requestHelp.description: Ask a trusted person to support the dispute.

offerSupport.label: Offer support · $20
offerSupport.description: Give financial support. Its provenance stays with the money.

negotiateBuyback.label: Negotiate buyback
negotiateBuyback.description: Try to lower the group’s demand, once per dispute.

discussSettlement.label: Discuss settlement
discussSettlement.description: Tell active leadership about the unauthorized incident.

outcomes.summary: Leadership may intervene on a later day

returnChains.label: Pay for the chains
returnChains.description: Meet the current demand and return the property to its owner.

outcomes.summary: Property returned; cash paid to the group

recoverProperty.label: Attempt property recovery
recoverProperty.description: An abstract, uncertain operation. Failure raises exposure and conflict.

outcomes.summary: Property returned or police and rival pressure

fullShift.label: Work a full shift
fullShift.description: Attend your scheduled shift. Build work skills and legitimacy. Requires an active job and today’s obligation.

localGig.label: Take a local gig
localGig.description: Earn $38 helping a local business in your neighborhood. One ordinary gig per day; no recurring obligation.

streetTransaction.label: Street work transaction
streetTransaction.description: Distribute merchandise you actually hold through a limited local market. Supplier balances remain owed.

outcomes.summary: Actual sales or loss; inventory, supplier debt and exposure persist

purchaseItem.label: Buy item
purchaseItem.description: Buy a personal item and reduce stress.

inviteToSet.label: Invite to your Set
inviteToSet.description: Requires free capacity, trust and willingness.

removeFromSet.label: Remove from Set
removeFromSet.description: Part ways. Identity and relationship history remain.

paidErrand.label: Assign a paid errand
paidErrand.description: Reserve an available member for a lawful errand due next day.

outcomes.summary: $24 clean income and member experience, or a failed obligation

localConnection.label: Build a local connection
localConnection.description: Help a member’s neighborhood. Build personal and organizational standing.

requestAffiliation.label: Request affiliation
requestAffiliation.description: A trusted member sponsors you when standing is sufficient.
